target.description: Representational tabletop oil paintings with recognizable food, fruit and vessels, naturalistic volume and one continuous scene. This is a bounded subject/treatment target, not an artist-style imitation.
include: Color oil painting with naturalistically modeled, recognizable food or fruit
A visible tabletop or cloth surface organizes one continuous still-life scene
Literal captions describe visible objects and setting without artist-name conditioning
exclude: Angular or deliberately flattened modernist treatment
Hanging single-subject studies and flowers without a tabletop food arrangement
Monochrome reproductions, fish, vanitas and trompe-l oeil subjects
Unresolved creator attribution or identity in a retained selected sample
Live animals and animal carcasses introduce subject matter outside the selected fruit, food and vessels treatment

exclusions.reason: Monochrome reproduction is outside the color tabletop target
exclusions.limitations: Source image and provider metadata retained; photographic reproduction may not reflect original colors

exclusions.reason: Fish subject outside the selected fruit, food and vessels target
exclusions.limitations: Metadata-only exclusion; source image was not acquired or visually judged in this review

exclusions.reason: Trompe-l oeil subject outside the selected tabletop target
exclusions.limitations: Metadata-only exclusion; source image unavailable locally
